reserveReview.rationale: Source recovery on 2026-10-09 recovered the rendered October 8 Asset Composition tab and its embedded asset_classes object. The five exact source percentages total 100%; the displayed two-decimal labels total 99.99% and are not normalized. Gross category values sum to the source denominator USD 63,270,977.76704198. The payload separately marks USD 28,867,528.97282344, or 45.62522975243257% of the whole book, across 430 liquid-hedge assets as unclassified. Category examples therefore do not establish all constituent identities, obligors or tracked dependencies. The same dashboard embeds all-scope supply including legacy Plasma V1 and Ethereum V2; the official directory distinguishes those claims. No exact V2 reserve/liability allocation or financial assurance is inferred from the pooled snapshot. Manual-review confidence is retained and the missing reserve-composition sentinel is not asserted closed. Observation review and genuine October 8 source date are separate; hedge coverage, maturity, liquidity and custody claims remain unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer October 8, 2026 Asset Composition gross asset_classes payload: liquid_hedge USD 42,976,684.69846544; stablecoins USD 15,933,440.12233126; staked_lst USD 3,663,048.489759372; cash_fiat USD 340,635.2837641548; tbill_rwa USD 357,169.1727217488; denominator USD 63,270,977.76704198. Copy source percentages at their published precision before hedge offsets; pooled reporting scope is not independently partitioned to canonical Ethereum V2.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four non-fiat baskets require constituent identity and dependency look-through, totaling 99.46162475152771%. Within the liquid-hedge category, the issuer explicitly marks 430 assets and 45.62522975243257% of the whole book unclassified; that amount is contained within the category and is not additional reserve weight. The 0.5383752484722824% fiat category identifies asset form but no named bank or settlement counterparty. Current V2-versus-legacy book partition, venue identities, hedge notional, liquidity, legal ownership and enforceable recovery remain unresolved. Named examples USYC and USDG establish no dependency weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: BTC, ETH, SOL and xNVDA are examples, not an exhaustive inventory. The source explicitly marks 430 assets, USD 28,867,528.97282344 and 45.62522975243257% of the whole book unclassified within this category. No untracked-only or fully hedged identity census is proved.
The payload counts eleven assets but does not supply exact identities and constituent weights. Accepted USDC/USDT deposits do not prove current reserve allocations.
The payload counts two assets; stETH and bnSOL are documented examples without constituent balances or weights. No synthetic-dollar dependency is inferred.
Fiat and FX balances at bank, venue or settlement accounts are not tracked stablecoin token holdings. No bank or account provider is identified.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deposit address is an entry point, not a whole-book custodian. Docs say no current off-exchange custody, while the same reporting-date dashboard assigns 2.83% to qualified custody and 1.04% to onchain derivatives margin. This contradiction remains unresolved, so custodyModel is unknown rather than a whole-book CEX or institutional tier. Dashboard location percentages are not named-provider shares or legal segregation evidence; no share is assigned to the deposit address or a guessed venue.
